problem_restatement: Resolve the first attributable source-native v51 SPCX lifecycle and determine whether its live protection and exit branch match the corrected report-only lifecycle tool without treating one profitable short as established edge.

corrected_replay_comparison.interpretation: The corrected tool reproduces the live exit mechanism and causal trigger bar, but first-complete-depth timing is not the backend poll and submission clock. Nominal economics were optimistic; stress was closer but still slightly optimistic. Use the replay for causal branch comparison, not exact live fill prediction.

analysis.diagnosis: The suspected missing SPCX profit-lock action was not a live defect. The live controller intentionally waits for completed-bar activation and a later completed-bar crossing, then sends a reduce-only close rather than amending the venue stop. That exact branch executed and reconciled flat. The replay's exit semantics passed, while its simplified timing and fill model remained optimistic relative to this live lifecycle.
failure_modes: The backend-only profit lock cannot protect the derived profit floor during a backend outage; only the original adverse stop is venue-native before trigger.
Completed-bar confirmation and poll latency can surrender more than the configured giveback during fast reversals or gaps.
One profitable short is entirely largest-winner dependent and says nothing about the configured long side.
The replay's first-complete-depth timing is not exact backend order-submission timing and can overstate economics.
analysis.falsifier: Technical parity is falsified by any later source-native v51 lifecycle whose bound live stop, opposite-intent, completed-bar profit-lock, maximum-hold branch, or flat/order reconciliation disagrees with the corrected replay contract. Economic optimism is updated by a compatible sample whose actual-minus-stress residual stabilizes materially away from zero.

recommendation.Recommendation: Keep the v51 SPCX route and its 100/40/80 completed-bar profit lock unchanged while collecting the opposite side and additional exact source-native lifecycles.
recommendation.Why now: The first source-native lifecycle has resolved and provides the first direct test of the corrected live/replay exit contract.
recommendation.Evidence reviewed: Independent source decision, live entry and protection rows, exact profit-lock decision, reduce-only close fills, fees, funding, completed-candle path, flat reconciliation, and immutable nominal/stress replay.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: The exit mechanism captured a profitable short and prevented full giveback, but retained only about 36% of gross MFE and the replay understated live execution drag.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: Source-native v51 SPCX 15-minute breakout-pressure entries with exact fresh top-ten pressure and the bound 100/40/80 completed-one-minute exit.
recommendation.Alternatives considered: Change the activation or giveback after one winner; replace the backend close with a venue-native trailing stop; remove the profit lock; or preserve the frozen contract and gather both-side evidence.
recommendation.Expected upside: Preserves the first technically validated index exit while avoiding a post-hoc retune based on one short winner.
recommendation.Main risks and failure modes: Sparse one-sided evidence, backend-only derived protection before trigger, completed-bar gap risk, replay timing optimism, and a possible opportunity cost if the short resumes after exit.
recommendation.Validation completed: Exact source/backend entry parity, venue protection, causal activation and trigger bars, reduce-only close, fill/fee/funding arithmetic, flat/order-free reconciliation, and corrected nominal/stress replay.
recommendation.Validation still required: At least one fully resolved long and additional short lifecycles, actual-minus-stress residual distribution, post-exit opportunity path, largest-winner sensitivity, and shared-portfolio interaction evidence.
recommendation.Success metrics: Exact exit-branch parity, no unprotected exposure or orphan orders, positive after-cost combined and side-separated economics, positive net excluding the largest winner once sample size permits, and bounded live-minus-stress execution residuals.
recommendation.Failure / rollback triggers: Any live/replay branch mismatch, unprotected lifecycle, stale or conflicting source attribution, repeated execution drag beyond stress, or a predeclared compatible sample with adverse after-cost expectancy.
recommendation.Confidence level: High technical confidence; low economic confidence from one resolved short.

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Resolve the still-open HYPE short under its native regime-aware exit and compare its realized result with the predeclared profit-lock challengers; continue SPCX long-side capture in parallel without changing v51.
